items.quote: Requests that read data require full access and also require an `application key`.
items.why: Says read requests need application key; no list of auth methods.

items.quote: Requests that write data require reporting access and require an `API key`.
items.why: Says write requests need API key; doesn't list auth methods or oauth2.

items.quote: Navigate to Organization settings, then click the API keys or Client Tokens tab.
items.why: Shows self-serve key location in Org settings; says nothing about trial gating.

items.quote: On the Free tier, you get up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention, at no cost.
items.why: States free tier limits and cost; doesn't say it yields working API keys.

items.quote: Application keys, in conjunction with your organization's API key, give users access to Datadog's programmatic API.
items.why: Confirms REST API access via app and API keys; no breadth or regional URLs.

items.quote: The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents
items.why: Directly states Datadog's own MCP Server exists. URL not in quote.

items.quote: The MCP Server has a fair-use burst limit of 50 tool calls per 10 seconds.
items.why: Rate limit detail; says nothing about MCP existence or vendor status.
